title: AIRA — what went through, and what it did

options.content:
**Every request the gateway served, and every configuration change that reached it.** Click a row to open the trace.

A request's own id comes back on the `x-trace-id` response header — paste it into *Explore → Tempo → TraceID* to go straight to one. Search indexes a minute behind; an id resolves at once.

Prompts and responses are **not** here and never will be: they are in `request_logs`, behind the use case's storage switch, its retention clock and a role check (`FRD-505`).

panels.title: Requests through the gateway
panels.description: One row per model call: who, which use case, which model, how it ended.

targets.query: { span.aira.operation != nil } | select(span.aira.use_case, span.aira.model, span.aira.outcome, span.aira.status, span.aira.total_tokens, span.aira.subject)

panels.title: Refused, and why
panels.description: Everything a control stopped — a budget, a rate limit, the pipeline, a suspension. `aira.outcome` is the closed vocabulary from `FRD-122`, so this is the same word the audit trail and the reports use.

targets.query: { span.aira.outcome != "served" } | select(span.aira.use_case, span.aira.model, span.aira.outcome, span.aira.status, span.aira.subject)

panels.title: Configuration reaching the gateway
panels.description: The other plane's half. A change made in the console and the gateway applying it are one trace (`FRD-615`), so this answers *when did it take effect* — and a red row is an event the consumer could not apply.

panels.title: Agents — offered against used
panels.description: How many functions a request handed the model, and how many it asked for. `offered` is recorded before anything can refuse, so a request stopped by a control still says it wanted tools — which is what makes 'offered ten, asked for none' different from 'offered none' (FRD-131 FR-7). Names only; arguments are caller content and stay under the storage switch and the retention clock.

targets.query: { span.aira.tools.offered > 0 } | select(span.aira.use_case, span.aira.model, span.aira.tools.offered, span.aira.tools.called, span.aira.tools.names, span.aira.outcome)
